question: What certain result follows after so many days?
premises: kāle tāvāddinair means in time after so many days
lakṣmīṃ bhūmyāḍhyāṃ labhate means obtains earth-wealthy Lakṣmī
inference: After so many days one certainly obtains Lakṣmī rich in earthly wealth.
plain_english: In time, after so many days, one certainly obtains Lakṣmī, wealthy in earth.
